Flooring FAQ

Which flooring works well for busy households?

Luxury vinyl plank and quality tile are popular because they provide durable surfaces and practical maintenance for active homes.

Do floors need leveling before installation?

Some properties require patching or leveling so the finished floor performs correctly. The condition must be evaluated before installation.
